subject: Workplace Skills
title: Walking Away Gracefully
description: Learn Walking Away Gracefully in one minute.

hook.text: The best negotiators know their walk-away point before entering the room. Without it, desperation takes over.

buildup.text: Your BATNA — best alternative to a negotiated agreement — determines your power. No alternative means no leverage.

discovery.text: Before any negotiation, define your minimum acceptable outcome. Below that line, you walk away. No exceptions.

twist.text: Willingness to walk away increases your power. Paradoxically, the less you need the deal, the better the terms.

climax.text: Build alternatives before negotiating: another offer, savings runway, or a plan B role. Alternatives create confidence.

punchline.text: Know your line. Build alternatives. Walk away if needed.

quiz.question: What is a BATNA in negotiation?
options: The maximum salary you're willing to accept
Your best alternative to a negotiated agreement, which determines your leverage
The budget allocated for the negotiation process
